ci.yml@stage-2:119-120 'Ask for the products through Caddy': 'curl --fail --silent --show-error --retry 30 --retry-delay 2 --retry-all-errors http://localhost:8080/api/v1/products'. Executed curl 8.9.0 with --fail on a 404: 'curl: (22) The requested URL returned error: 404', exit=22. GitHub workflow syntax: bash steps run as 'bash --noprofile --norc -eo pipefail {0}', so a non-zero exit fails the step. Staging log L503 runs this step after 'up' (L234).
